case_name: Rohit Kumar Sachdeva S/O Hukum Chand vs State Of Uttarakhand

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Uttarakhand, through its Secretary Home, and others

facts_of_case: Matrimonial discord between respondent No.3 Nisha Sachdeva and the petitioner Rohit Kumar Sachdeva; FIR lodged under Section 498A and 420 of IPC; petition for quashing of FIR.

legal_principles.principle: A petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution can be used to quash a First Information Report.
legal_principles.held: By means of this petition moved under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has sought quashing of the First Information Report dated 17.01.2013.

legal_principles.principle: A divorce petition filed under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 can be used to quash a First Information Report.
legal_principles.held: It is alleged by the respondent No.3 Nisha Sachdeva (complainant) that her husband (present petitioner) fraudulently, got her signatures in the divorce papers.

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's petition for quashing of FIR allowed; interim measure directed that petitioner shall not be arrested during investigation, provided he cooperates with the investigating agency.

use_for_drafting: drafting a quashing petition under Article 226
responding to a criminal writ petition in the Uttarakhand High Court
advising on divorce and IPC-related matters
